scenarios.label: Pick or pass
scenarios.description: Seat 1 holds JC, 8D, 8S, QH, KH, KD and must PICK or PASS. (This seat goes on to pick.)

scenarios.label: Call a partner
scenarios.description: Seat 1 picked and now holds JC, 8D, 8S, QH, KH, KD, 9S, KC (8 cards after the blind). It must choose a partner card — the two-tower CALL scorer is the live head here.

scenarios.label: Bury two cards
scenarios.description: Seat 1 (the picker) holds JC, 8D, 8S, QH, KH, KD, 9S, KC and must bury its first card — the pointer head scores every hand slot.

scenarios.label: Lead trick 1
scenarios.description: Seat 1 (the picker) leads trick 1 with JC, 8D, 8S, QH, KD, KC. The trick is empty; memory carries everything up to this lead.

scenarios.label: Follow late in the hand
scenarios.description: Trick 3: seat 1 (the picker) follows with JC, 8S, QH, KC after several cards hit the table. Trick tokens are live and the memory token carries every completed trick.
